args.code: (() => { let total = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { let count = 0; const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (let b of btns) { const text = b.textContent; if (text.includes('知道了') || text.includes('确定') || text.includes('领取奖励') || text.includes('取消')) { b.click(); count++; } } total += count; if (count === 0) break; } return 'closed ' + total + ' popups'; })()
